Summary: The 2017 paper "Attention is All You Need" by Ashish Vaswani et al. introduced the Transformer architecture, which relies solely on attention mechanisms and has become a foundational design for modern large language models and much of today’s NLP stack. The paper was presented at the 31st Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NIPS) and published in Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems. The Transformer model has been shown to deliver state-of-the-art translation quality with lower training costs by making long-range dependencies easier to learn and training more parallelizable.
